name: Banana Company
summary:
Banana.Co is a fun and engaging virtual reality game where players embody bananas in a whimsical world. Inspired by Gorilla Tag mechanics, it offers a lighthearted adventure perfect for those aged 13 and up. We welcome everyone as long as they practice safe gaming.

Community Guidelines: Our inclusive community prioritizes enjoyment and respect. A dedicated moderation team ensures a safe and friendly environment.
